reviews.body: **Devin Review** found 1 potential issue.
thank you, lgtm! left a small suggestion, could you also sign the CLA? it's still showing as not signed

review_comments.body:
🟡 **Empty override drops the transcription language** With `language=""`, `STT.stream()` replaces the configured language with an empty `LanguageCode`. `SpeechStream._run` then omits `language_code`, so AWS rejects the request without automatic identification.
Learn more The constructor treats an empty language as `en-US` in [STT.__init__](https://github.com/livekit/agents/blob/8f55f892bb3f8dc714952c1aa57d9eacd5f5ace8/livekit-plugins/livekit-plugins-aws/livekit/plugins/aws/stt.py#L151-L154 "livekit-plugins/livekit-plugins-aws/livekit/plugins/aws/stt.py:151-154"). The stream override instead stores an empty string. [SpeechStream._run](https://github.com/livekit/agents/blob/8f55f892bb3f8dc714952c1aa57d9eacd5f5ace8/livekit-plugins/livekit-plugins-aws/livekit/plugins/aws/stt.py#L319-L321 "livekit-plugins/livekit-plugins-aws/livekit/plugins/aws/stt.py:319-321") only sends `language_code` when that stored string is truthy, leaving a non-identification request without a language. **Example:** `STT(language="fr-FR").stream(language="")` previously sent `fr-FR`; the new code sends no `language_code`, and AWS rejects the stream instead of using the constructor's `en-US` fallback. **Recommended fix:** Apply the constructor's `language or "en-US"` fallback when building the stream override, and test an empty override against the generated request.
```suggestion if is_given(language) and not (opts.identify_language or opts.identify_multiple_languages): opts = replace(opts, language=LanguageCode(language or "en-US")) ``` --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

The empty-override issue Devin flagged is real (`stream(language="")` stores `""`, `_run` then omits `language_code`, and AWS rejects a request with no language and no identification), but falling back to `"en-US"` would override the configured language, e.g. `STT(language="fr-FR").stream(language="")` would send `en-US`. An empty override should just mean no override and keep the configured language:

```suggestion
        if language and not (opts.identify_language or opts.identify_multiple_languages):
            opts = replace(opts, language=LanguageCode(language))
```

Could you also add a case to the test asserting `provider.stream(language="")._opts.language == "en-US"`?
✅ **Resolved**: Resolved: an empty language is now falsy, so stream() keeps the configured language instead of replacing it with an empty LanguageCode.

we should throw a warning when the language is ignored because of language identification, so users can expect it
```suggestion
        opts = self._config
        # language_code cannot be combined with automatic language identification
        if language and (opts.identify_language or opts.identify_multiple_languages):
            logger.warning(
                "language is ignored when identify_language or identify_multiple_languages is enabled"
            )
        elif language:
            opts = replace(opts, language=LanguageCode(language))
```

comments.body:
Thanks, applied as suggested: an empty `language` now means no override and keeps the configured language (`STT(language="fr-FR").stream(language="")` no longer ends up with an empty or `en-US` code). `test_aws_stream_applies_language_override` now also asserts that `stream(language="")._opts.language == "en-US"` for a provider configured with `en-US`.

This change was made with Claude Code.
